name: Shooting Majestic Star Dragon
card_text:
"Majestic Dragon" + 1+ non-Tuners, including a Dragon Synchro Monster
Must first be Synchro Summoned. Once per turn: You can negate the effects of 1 Effect Monster your opponent controls. Gains 1 additional attack each Battle Phase for every monster in your GY that is "Stardust Dragon" or is a Synchro Monster that mentions it. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can banish this card (until the End Phase), and if you do, negate the activation, and if you do that, banish that card.
